decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height:normal"><b>Landscaping Implementation</b></span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 36pt;"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm;"><span style="line-height:normal">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.</span></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height:normal"><b>Change of Use (flats)</b></span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 36pt;"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm;"><span style="line-height:normal">The flats hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.</span></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height:normal"><b>Refuse&nbsp;Storage</b></span></p><p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 36pt;"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm;">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until details of refuse storage of 3 bins per flat, located within the front garden have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the flats here by permitted.&nbsp;</p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm;"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-top: 0cm;"><br></p>

<p style="margin-left: 25px; text-align: justify; padding: 3pt;"><u>Cycle Parking</u></p><p style="margin-left: 23px; text-align: justify; padding: 3pt;">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until details of secured and sheltered cycle storage for 2 bicycles per flat, located within the front garden have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the approved cycle storage shall be made available prior to the occupation of the development in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter. be retained.</p><p style="text-align: justify; padding: 3pt;"><br></p>
<p>Within 3 months of this permission the internal boundary fence in the rear garden and any supporting posts should be removed prior to the occupation of the flats.<br></p><p><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:0cm"><span style="line-height: normal;"><b>Landscaping</b></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:0cm"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:0cm">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority in writing, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the the site. Soft landscape works shall include: defensible planting to the front elevation, planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities, written specification of planting and cultivations to be undertaken. The subdivided rear garden should be reverted back to its original state prior to occupation.</p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; margin-right:0cm; margin-top:0cm"><br></p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: 240629-00 Rev01;&nbsp;240629-01;&nbsp;240629-02 Rev01;&nbsp;240629-03 Rev01;&nbsp;240629-04 Rev01;&nbsp;240629-05 Rev01; 240629-06 Rev01;&nbsp;<span style="font-size:12pt">240629-07;&nbsp;</span>Design &amp; Access Statement; Fire Safety Statement.
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse into two flats (2 X 1 bed); separate amenity space; bin / cycle storage
